regime_context: The absolute-trend gate narrows the HK universe to 5 eligible themes, led by Tech Hardware & Semis (headline, durability 0.61, trend). Cross-sectional momentum ranks Miners first but it fails the gate. Rotation is non-directional, breadth is narrowing, and no single narrative dominates. All scorable ETF proxies belong to ineligible themes, making any directional call unscorable and inherently low-confidence. Macro backdrop is AI-tech heavy with high unscheduled news share.
emerging_watch: Watch for Tech Hardware & Semis durability_bar to drop below 0.6 and lose eligibility, which would indicate the absolute trend has deteriorated and retire the overweight lean. The observable condition is the detector's next print showing the theme ineligible.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Tech Hardware & Semis is the highest-ranked eligible theme and the headline, passing the absolute-trend gate with durability just above threshold and trend structure intact. Low breadth (0.17) signals narrow leadership and fragility. The gate's validated risk control supports a small directional lean provided the trend holds, but no alpha is claimed.
evidence: Headline theme in narrative rotation, hurst_tag 'trend'.
